* Drive AI adoption across global business units, regional organizations and functional teams.
* Establish robust governance covering AI ethics, data management, cybersecurity, regulatory compliance and responsible AI practices.
* Develop strategic partnerships with leading technology providers, universities, research institutions and AI ecosystem partners.
* Inspire cross\-functional teams to accelerate innovation and deliver measurable business outcomes.



  





**About You** 



* 8\+ years' experience leading AI, digital transformation, technology or innovation functions within complex global organisations.

* Strong knowledge of modern AI and data ecosystems, including cloud platforms, MLOps, data engineering and technologies such as Databricks, Kafka or comparable enterprise platforms.
* Deep understanding of artificial intelligence, Generative AI, machine learning and customer\-centric digital product development.
* Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence executive leadership, business units, engineering teams and external partners.
* Experience leading geographically distributed, cross\-functional teams in international environments.
* A strategic mindset balanced with the ability to execute and deliver tangible results.



  





**Ideal Background** 




 We are particularly interested in leaders from sectors such as:
 



  




* Industrial Technology
* Smart Manufacturing
* Industrial IoT
* Building Technologies
* Water Infrastructure \& Utilities
* Critical Infrastructure
* Digital Platforms
* AI\-enabled Software \& Technology



  





 Experience within engineering\-led or industrial organizations would be highly advantageous, although exceptional candidates from adjacent technology sectors will also be considered.
 



  





**Why This Role?** 




 This is more than a leadership position, it is an opportunity to define how AI shapes the future of a global organisation.
 



  





 You will have executive sponsorship, significant investment, and the autonomy to build a best\-in\-class AI function that delivers real commercial impact across international markets.
 



  





 If you are excited by the opportunity to build, lead and scale enterprise AI on a global stage, we would welcome a confidential discussion.

The incumbent is accountable as subject Matter Expert on areas related to IS / Digital \& Platforms, Technology Infrastructure, Cyber Security and Business continuity \& DR.
   

  

**Position Information**
**Title: Senior Audit Engagement Manager/ Audit Engagement Manager, Technology Audit (IS Audit)**

* Division: Internal Audit Centre of Excellence
* Location: HQ


**Grade**
* Audit Engagement Manager: P5

* Bachelor’s in IT /Computer Science / Engineering (Computer/Network/Telecom) or related subjects.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Identify key control points, applicable regulations (e.g., FSA), and relevant frameworks (IPPF, COBIT, NIST standards, Telecom specific standards) to be used as criteria for the audit engagement.


**Engagement Execution (Field work)**
* Execute audit procedures in accordance with approved audit programs and methodologies.
* Perform walkthroughs, control testing, data analysis, and evidence validation.
* Identify control deficiencies, risk exposures, and process improvement opportunities.
* Conduct root cause analysis and evaluate business impact of findings.
* Ensure professional skepticism and independence throughout audit execution.


**Reporting**
* Prepare clear, concise, and risk\-focused audit reports.
* Document audit findings with: Condition, criteria, cause, impact and Practical and actionable recommendations.
* Discuss findings with management and obtain agreement on action plans and timelines.
* Present audit results in closing meetings, clearly articulating key risks and insights.
* Ensure timely issuance of final audit reports in line with agreed timelines.


**Documentation \& Quality Assurance**
* Maintain complete, accurate, and well\-structured audit working papers within the Audit Management System ensuring that the working papers support the audit findings and conclusions.

**Follow\-Up of Audit Findings \& Validation**
* Track implementation of agreed management action plans against the reported audit findings.

**Stakeholder Engagement \& Continuous Improvement**

* Plan, perform and report on Advisory engagements as per the approved methodology ensuring quality standards.
* Build effective relationships with the key stakeholders.


 Contribute to continuous enhancement of audit methodologies, tools, and practices.

As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Business Director, you’ll lead and grow our senior client relationships in Kuwait, working with leading regional and multinational clients across the GCC. In the Middle East, Monks is rapidly expanding its footprint, and we are looking for a commercially driven, client\-obsessed leader to serve as a trusted strategic advisor to C\-suite and senior marketing leadership. We are looking for someone who is passionate about seeking new opportunities to create impactful work.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Serve as the primary executive point of contact for a portfolio of senior clients in Kuwait and the broader Gulf region.
* Build and maintain C\-suite relationships, acting as a strategic advisor who deeply understands their business objectives and digital maturity.
* Lead quarterly business reviews (QBRs), annual planning sessions, and executive presentations.
* Own revenue targets for your portfolio, with accountability for retention, growth, and profitability.
* Identify and convert organic growth opportunities across Monks' full service offering, including creative production, media, data, and tech.
* Oversee responses to pitches, RFPs, and new business opportunities within the region.
* Negotiate contracts, scopes of work, and commercial terms in collaboration with finance and operations.
* Translate complex digital marketing challenges into clear strategic recommendations and compelling Monks solutions.
* Champion the use of Monks' proprietary technology, AI\-powered tools, and data capabilities.
* Lead and motivate cross\-functional delivery teams, ensuring high standards of work quality.
* Mentor and develop junior client services team members while contributing to the culture in Kuwait.


**About You**
 The essentials:
   

  

  

* 10\+ years of experience in digital marketing, advertising, or MarTech, with at least 4 years in a senior client leadership role.
* Bilingual proficiency with outstanding written and verbal communication skills in both English and Arabic.
* Commercial Acumen: Proven track record managing and growing large, complex accounts (ideally $1M\+ annual revenue) and comfort with P\&L and forecasting.
* Market Expertise: Culturally fluent with a deep appreciation for the nuances of doing business in the Gulf; experience in Kuwait or the broader GCC is strongly preferred.
* Strategic Depth: Deep knowledge of the digital landscape, including platforms, paid media, social, CRM, and data \& analytics.
* Executive Presence: Exceptional relationship\-building skills with the ability to operate at the board and C\-suite level.
* Leadership: A natural collaborator who can lead cross\-functional teams within a complex, matrixed global organisation.


**Not a Must, But a Plus**
* Background: Experience working within a global agency network, top\-tier consultancy, or specialised marketing technology company.
* AI \& Tech Focus: A specific passion for emerging AI\-driven tools and their application in the evolving digital landscape.
* Entrepreneurial Spirit: A mindset that actively seeks out opportunity and takes the initiative to pursue it.
* Cultural Pulse: A passion for staying on the pulse of culture and the ability to provide a strategic POV.


*At Monks, we believe in fostering an environment where a diversity of perspectives can thrive. We proactively work to design hiring processes that promote equity and inclusion while mitigating bias. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage qualified applicants, from all backgrounds, who are excited to contribute to our mission.*
**About Monks**
 Monks is the global, digital\-first, data\-driven, unitary operating brand of S4 Capital plc. With a legacy of innovation and specialized expertise, Monks combines an extraordinary range of global Marketing and Technology Services to redefine how brands interact with the world. Through Monks.Flow, its flagship AI ecosystem for marketing orchestration, Monks transforms marketing into a growth engine, collapsing timelines and connecting brands to culture in real time. By deploying bespoke intelligent agents across disciplines and delivering culturally relevant, high\-impact creative and digital solutions, Monks solves key critical business challenges across the entire brand enterprise to help brands sustain long\-term impact.
   

  

 Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services, ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022\-25\) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020\-24\). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023\) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization, Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2025 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in both the Organizational and AI Product categories. As a trusted partner to cutting\-edge innovators in tech, Monks earned titles such as Optimizely Experimentation Partner of the Year (2025\), runner\-up for the Adobe Firefly Partner Award (2024\), and Workato’s AI Visionary Customer Impact Award (2024\). Additionally, Monks achieved a record\-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.
   

  

 We are an equal\-opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.

**The Company** 




 The Mauritius Commercial Bank Ltd (MCB) is the leading financial institution in Mauritius and a key player in the African banking landscape. As part of the largest banking group in Mauritius (MCB Group) and with over 187 years of history, MCB has built a strong reputation for innovation, customer\-centric solutions, and financial stability.
 



  





 Under its Vision 2030 strategic plan, MCB is pursuing a deliberate strategy of focusing on specialized, high\-expertise niche segments across the African continent while also leveraging on its hubs in Nairobi, Johannesburg, Lagos, Paris and Dubai.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 As
 **Head of Digital Assets and Emerging Technologies** 
 , you will embark on a journey with our
 **Customer Experience \& Marketing SBU** 
 , where the shared ambition is to craft a brand that deeply resonates with its audiences, providing them with a simple, personalized, and meaningful experience.
 



  





 You will report directly to the Chief Customer Experience Officer (CXO) and will have direct accountability over two streams: (1\) the existing AI COE team, providing strategic direction and governance over the bank's artificial intelligence capabilities; and (2\) a new Digital Assets team, responsible for building the bank's position in virtual assets, custody, blockchain, stablecoins, and tokenisation.
 



  





 The role combines strategic vision with hands\-on execution authority, interfacing with the Board, regulators, leadership team, lines of business, strategic partners, and clients.
 



  





**📍Location: Mauritius (Preferred) \| Hybrid: Mauritius / Dubai** 




  





**The Role** 




 Enterprise Strategy \& Roadmap
 


* Define and continuously evolve the Emerging Technologies strategy and three\-year execution roadmap aligned to enterprise priorities, risk appetite, and regulatory requirements.
* Build and manage a structured innovation pipeline: use\-case identification, prioritization, business cases, and scaling paths across lines of business.
* Establish clear value\-tracking for initiatives and report progress and portfolio KPIs to CXO/ governance forums.



  





 AI Leadership
 


* Provide strategic directions to the AI team: adoption across business lines, operating model, prioritized backlog, and delivery governance.
* Drive responsible AI by embedding risk, model governance, and regulatory readiness into AI solution design and deployment.
* Expand AI capabilities into high\-value domains and ensure solutions meet customer and business requirements.



  





 Digital Assets Leadership
 


* Create and scale the bank’s Digital Assets agenda including tokenization, custody, stablecoin\-related propositions, partnerships, and future\-fit solutions.
* Lead end\-to\-end product and solution development for Digital Asset services: target operating model, product architecture, ecosystem partner selection, and go\-to\-market coordination
* Monitor market and regulatory evolution and translate developments into actionable roadmap decisions.



  





 Governance, Risk, Compliance \& Regulatory Engagement (Portfolio\-wide)
 


* Embedded the governance framework for the Emerging Technologies portfolio: policies, controls, risk registers and compliance requirements.
* Serve as a senior point of contact with regulators for emerging technology matters; ensure regulatory inquiries, examinations, and responses are coordinated and defensible.
* Build/maintain procedures with Risk, Compliance, Legal, AML and Technology to ensure products and platforms meet internal and external obligations.



  





 Stakeholder, Board \& Ecosystem Leadership
 


* Orchestrate internal alignment across CXO, CIO/, SBU heads, and control functions to enable efficient execution and scaling of initiatives.
* Build and maintain strategic partnerships (technology providers, fintechs, custodians, blockchain networks, universities/innovation ecosystems) and represent the bank in industry forums as required.
* Provide credible executive\-level communication to senior leaders/board committees on strategy, progress, risk posture, and investment trade\-offs.



  





 Budget, Operating Discipline \& Delivery Execution
 


* Develop and manage budget plans in alignment with the CXO for roadmap delivery, including investment cases and resourcing plans.
* Establish delivery governance: portfolio cadence, project/program controls, resourcing allocation, and corrective actions when needed.



  





 Organization \& Capability Building
 


* Build a high\-performing Emerging Technologies function: structure, role definitions, hiring plan, capability framework, and career paths across AI and Digital Assets.
* Attract specialist talent and embed knowledge transfer through coaching, learning pathways, and local bench\-strength development.



  





**The Profile** 




 Education:
 


* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as IT, engineering, or finance.
* A Master’s degree ideally in AI, IT, FinTech, or business/ strategy would be an advantage.



  





 Experience:
 


* 10 years of broad and deep experience in virtual assets, blockchain, stablecoins, and tokenisation.
* 3 years of managerial experience leading multi\-disciplinary teams and delivering strategic objectives.



  





 Domain exposure:
 


* Regulated financial services and emerging technologies (AI, digital assets/blockchain), including evidence of product delivery and governance in regulated environments.



  





***A combination of both qualifications \& experience will be considered.***




  





 Should this opportunity match your career aspirations, skills and competencies, click on ‘Apply’ to complete your online application.
 



  





 Please ensure all required information is accurately entered in relevant sections. Any incomplete application will not be considered. Kindly attach a complete CV when applying.
 



  





 As part of the recruitment process, candidates will be required to provide a valid Certificate of Character of less than 3 months and two professional references.
 



  





 The deadline for submission of application is
 **08 July 2026\.** 




  





***Management reserves the right not to appoint anyone following this advert.***

The primary focus will be on identifying emerging technologies and cutting\-edge processes and orchestrating their seamless integration into our business operations.
   

  

 Digital Office Manager will serve as the connection between conceptualizing transformative ideas and executing practical solutions. The mission is not only to keep a vigilant eye on the technological landscape but also to align these advancements with our organizational goals. By leveraging your expertise, the role holder will contribute to the development and implementation of innovative strategies that drive our digital transformation agenda forward.
   

  

 The role demands a visionary mindset and a proactive approach to problem\-solving. The Digital Office Manager will be instrumental in shaping and executing our digital strategy, ensuring that each digital engagement is finely tuned to meet our business objectives. The impact will extend beyond traditional boundaries by guiding the team in harnessing the power of digital technologies to address complex challenges and optimize operational efficiency.

* Act as the single point of contact and key advisor to relevant QAFCO executives for digital topics and the future of the business, providing strategic guidance and insights.
* Act as the face of QAFCO in local and global digital and innovation events, seminars, and associations, representing the organization and fostering relationships with key stakeholders in the digital ecosystem.
* Interpret the digital strategy and identify innovative solutions supporting strategy implementation.
* Manage and evaluate the portfolio/pipeline of innovative ideas collected from across the company.
* Work closely with relevant business stakeholders to understand operational challenges or threats.
* Lead teams to build and implement digital products, tracking implementation progress and ensuring alignment with business and IT.

* Lead the ideation program to identify digital opportunities, ensuring compliance with relevant quality, health, safety, and environmental management procedures and controls.


**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Certifications in project management, such as PMP (Project Management Professional) would be added as an advantage.

 We are recruiting three Digital Business Partners for Hamad International Airport ,Doha, Qatar.
 



 The Digital Business Partners act as the key business relationship interface between airport’s IT department and one of the assigned business units (
 **Airport Ops Control Centre, Facilities Management, and Customer experience** 
 ),
 
 to strategically align technology initiatives with business goals, foster strong partnership\-based relationships, maximize business value from IT investments through collaboration, and shape demand for solutions and business services.
 



  





  





**About the role**




  





  




* The Digital Business Partner is responsible to translate business demand, opportunities, constraints and risks through structured requirements gathering and prioritization processes to achieve effective governance, portfolio planning and informed investment decisions.
* Accountable to maintain a strong understanding of the assigned business domain through continuous engagement with business processes, services, challenges and opportunities to achieve relevant, value\-adding digital advice and recommendations.
* Identify and promote innovation, digital transformation and data\-led improvement opportunities through business insight and cross\-functional collaboration to achieve enhanced service quality, operational efficiency, resilience and customer experience.
* Collaborate and ensure the development and maintenance of technology and capability plans, strategy and roadmaps and improvement priorities through business and IT collaboration to achieve alignment between digital initiatives and operational and strategic objectives.
* Support, and be actively involved, in building the business requirements specific to AI product development within the assigned business domain.
* Support the resolution of conflicting requirements, priorities and stakeholder expectations through effective communication, escalation and negotiation to achieve balanced decisions and sustained alignment across business and IT teams.
* Ensure regular service reviews, stakeholder discussions and feedback sessions through structured engagement forums to achieve improved service performance, stakeholder satisfaction and closure of agreed actions.
* Contribute to demand planning, annual planning cycles, budget input and supplier interface activities through portfolio analysis and stakeholder engagement to achieve effective prioritization and delivery of agreed business needs.
* Responsible to identify and track continual service improvement actions and business value outcomes through performance reviews and benefit monitoring to achieve improved services, processes and business outcomes.



  





  





**Qualifications**




  





  




* High School Qualification / Vocational Qualification /Diploma or Equivalent (Type of Diploma Based on Role) with Minimum 7 years of job\-related experience
* Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent with Minimum 6 years of job\-related experience
* Airport Experience is mandatory
* Relevant experience in IT business partnering, service delivery, demand management, business analysis, project delivery or a related digital/technology environment .
* Professional and excellent command of English language is mandatory .
* Experience in supporting projects, service enhancements, change initiatives or digital transformation activities within a structured delivery and governance framework
* Good understanding of change management, process improvement and the use of digital tools and data in order to enhance service effectiveness and business outcomes.
* Working knowledge of IT service management principles, service lifecycle processes and performance measurement concepts, preferably aligned to recognized good practice frameworks

data.jd_text:
We are seeking a highly skilled and driven professional to lead the support, configuration, and continuous enhancement of our DXC Assure Health Insurance platform. In this pivotal role, you will not only act as the technical authority for complex incidents and drive system stability and performance, but also lead and mentor a team of support engineers, fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement. You will play a key role in shaping the future of our health insurance operations through smart configuration, data integration, and automation, while collaborating with cross\-functional teams and influencing critical business outcomes. If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment, enjoy leading people and solving complex challenges, and are passionate about delivering impactful solutions, we would love to hear from you.
 



  





***Major Responsibilities:***



* Act as the primary escalation point for all DXC Assure V4 and Assure Health platform incidents and service requests
* Lead end\-to\-end product configuration and setup activities on the Assure Health platform, including benefit plan setup, product rules, tariff structures, member eligibility configurations, etc
* Design, implement, and govern configuration management processes to ensure all platform setups are version\-controlled, tested, and documented
* Assist business units to optimize and streamline operations using capabilities of the platform
* Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for P1/P2 incidents and implement permanent corrective actions
* Oversee Microsoft SQL Server database administration tasks including query optimisation, stored procedure review, index management, and performance tuning in support of platform operations
* Architect and govern ETL processes for data migration, member onboarding, claims feeds, and third\-party integrations; review and approve ETL job designs produced by the team
* Collaborate with DXC vendor teams on release management, platform upgrades, hotfix deployments, and configuration migrations across environments
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to mid\-level and junior support engineers on SQL, ETL, and Assure Health configuration best practices
* Develop and maintain runbooks, SOPs, configuration guides, and technical knowledge base documentation
* Coordinate with internal business stakeholders (Health Operations, Finance, Underwriting, Claims) on system changes and new product launches
* Participate in change reviews, and user requirement analysis for platform\-impacting configuration and infrastructure changes
* Ensure compliance with information security policies, data governance standards, and regulatory requirements applicable to health insurance data



  





***Qualifications \& Skills Required:***



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
* 5\+ years of experience in enterprise application support and configuration, with at least 2 years on DXC Assure V4 / Assure Health or an equivalent health insurance platform
* Strong knowledge of health insurance domain processes including policy administration, benefits management, member enrolment, claims processing, and provider networks
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft SQL Server — complex query writing, stored procedures, views, performance tuning, SQL Server Agent job management, and SSMS
* Hands\-on experience with SSIS ETL tool for data migration, transformation, and integration pipeline development and monitoring
* Experience with ITSM platforms and ITIL incident, problem, and change management processes
* Familiarity with Azure or AWS cloud infrastructure, REST APIs, SFTP\-based file exchanges, and middleware integration patterns
* Microsoft Azure certifications will be an added advantage
* ITIL v4 certification will be an added advantage
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to engage C\-level stakeholders and translate technical detail into business impact
* Strategic thinker with strong analytical and problem\-solving ability
* Composed under pressure; effective incident commander during high\-severity platform outages
* Collaborative leadership style; able to influence without direct authority across technical and business teams
* Self\-motivated with a continuous improvement and automation mindset
* Detail\-oriented with a commitment to rigorous documentation and knowledge sharing

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 The Manager, Data Domain and Products is accountable for governing, coordinating, and enabling a portfolio of data domains and their associated data products, rather than owning a single domain directly.
   

  

 The role ensures that domain data owners (Principal Specialists) operate within a consistent enterprise framework for data products, governance, quality, and value realization. It acts as the portfolio‑level authority, aligning domain priorities with enterprise strategy, resolving cross‑domain conflicts, and ensuring that data products are delivered as reusable, governed assets rather than siloed solutions.
   

  

 This role is responsible for how data domains operate together, how data products are prioritized and standardized, and how domain outputs collectively support enterprise reporting, operations, controls, and decision‑making.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Provide leadership and oversight across multiple data domains, each owned by a designated domain owner
* Ensure domain owners apply consistent principles for data ownership, stewardship, modeling, quality, and governance.
* Balance demand across domains by prioritizing data products based on enterprise value, regulatory need, and readiness.
* Ensure domain data products integrate cleanly with enterprise platforms and downstream consumers.
* Act as the primary business‑facing interface for enterprise data domains, translating strategic needs into coordinated domain roadmaps.
* Enable domain owners to focus on execution by removing blockers, resolving dependencies, and clarifying priorities.
* Ensure lifecycle artifacts (ownership, definitions, quality expectations, refresh SLAs) are consistently produced across domains.
* Lead and develop domain owners, ensuring clarity of role boundaries between domain ownership and enterprise oversight.


**Minimum Qualification, Experience And Competencies**
**Minimum Qualification**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Cloud Computing, or related field.
* MBA or Master’s degree or equivalent professional experience is an advantage.


**Minimum Experience**
* 12\+ years of experience across data, analytics, or enterprise information management
* Proven experience leading multiple data domains or portfolios, not just a single domain
* Demonstrated ability to manage senior specialists and influence cross‑functional stakeholders


**Skills**
* Portfolio‑level data domain and product management
* Enterprise data governance and operating models
* Cross‑domain KPI and semantic alignment
* Stakeholder management at senior business and technical levels
* Ability to translate strategy into coordinated execution across multiple owners

**Join the House of AMOUAGE** 




  





 Are you ready to lead the commercial success of the iconic House of AMOUAGE in its home and flagship market?
 



 We are seeking an Associate Director — Sales to lead our Oman Commercial organisation, with accountability for Retail, Wholesale \& Duty Free, and Corporate Sales across the Sultanate.
 



  





**Your Purpose** 




 Reporting to the Head of Global Retail \& GM Oman, the Associate Director — Sales leads the commercial performance of Oman across all channels, driving revenue growth, profitability, and brand excellence. As steward of Amouage's flagship market, the role ensures the successful execution of commercial strategy, develops high\-performing teams, and represents the maison with key partners and stakeholders across Oman.
 



  





**Your Impact** 




  





**Commercial leadership across channels** 



* Deliver Oman's multi\-channel commercial plan — revenue, margin, channel mix, brand health
* Set channel priorities across Retail, Wholesale \& DF, Corporate Sales a — including investment trade\-offs
* Hold each Area Sales Manager and Corporate Sales Manager accountable to commercial targets and brand standards.



  





**Flagship market stewardship** 



* Protect Oman's positioning as the home market and the flagship — heritage, palace relationships, brand significance
* Represent Amouage at senior level with palace, government, landlords and key partners
* Champion Oman as the proving ground for Retail — ensure new global standards are deployed locally with rigour and feed learnings back
* Sponsor flagship moments — major events, press, VIP hosting, royal engagements.



  





**Team leadership and development** 



* Build a high\-performing senior team across the Oman commercial organisation
* Drive succession depth at the management tier
* Set the cultural tone for Oman commercial — performance, brand standards, collaboration across channels
* Mentor the Corporate Sales Manager Jr and Oman Retail Training Manager Jr as the management bench builds.



  





**Operational governance** 



* Own Oman commercial operating expenses, capex requests and channel investment within Group DOA
* Sign off boutique\-level decisions of material commercial impact (new sites, refits, large events, exceptional discounting)
* Ensure compliance with Group policy across all channels — SOPs, segregation of duties, data privacy, audit remediation.



  





**Strategic feedback to Global Retail** 



* Feed back Oman performance, learnings and market intelligence to the Head of Global Retail
* Inform global retail standards through Oman's role as the proving ground.



  





**Your Journey With Us** 




 The House of AMOUAGE has been on an aggressive growth trajectory within the fast\-growing ultra luxury perfumes segment, unlocking tremendous personal and career development opportunities for our team members across multiple locations including Muscat, Dubai, New York, Seoul and Kuala Lumpur. We foresee the incumbent of this role to grow in this opportunity together with AMOUAGE.
 



  





**Your Expertise** 



* Bachelor's degree required; MBA or equivalent senior commercial qualification preferred
* 12\+ years in senior commercial leadership, ideally in luxury, premium beauty or hospitality
* Demonstrable multi\-channel commercial track record
* Senior stakeholder management at palace / government / partner level in the GCC
* Current or previous experience in Oman would be strongly preferred
* Fluent English; Arabic strongly preferred.



  





**The AMOUAGE Advantage** 




 Join a House that has been creating luxury fragrance experiences since 1983\. At AMOUAGE, you'll be part of a legacy that combines artisanal craftsmanship with modern innovation, bringing extraordinary olfactory experiences to clients worldwide.

**About Ego**
**Ego Pharmaceuticals** 
 is a proudly Australian\-owned manufacturer of science\-backed skincare. For over 70 years, we’ve combined heritage with innovation to transform lives through the science of healthy skin. From our family\-founded roots to becoming a global force, we manufacture all our products \- including iconic brands like

**If you’re looking to contribute to a legacy of excellence, your journey starts here.**
**Business Manager Oman \& Bahrain**
 📍Oman \| 🕜 Full Time \| 🌏 Dual Region
   

  

 We are excited to announce that we are now actively recruiting for a
 **Business Manager Oman \& Bahrain** 
 , based in
 **Oman**
**About The Role**
 The Business Manager is primarily responsible for leading Ego Pharmaceuticals commercial team across the Country to maximize
   

  

 performance and profitability. This will be achieved through empowering and motivating the commercial team to achieve sales targets
   

  

 through monitoring and evaluating team performance and providing professional and technical support when required.
   

  

 This role will consistently demonstrate and represent the Ego values and spirit to our external partners and internal workforce.
   

  

 Key responsibilities and requirements of the role include:
   

  

* Understand market dynamics and adapt a strategy to grow Ego business across different trade channels within the country to drive leadership position and market share within our category.
* Setting key account targets and ensuring these targets are achieved through executing account plans and providing technical support
* Evaluating team performance and providing coaching and training to develop the commercial teams sales capabilities to drive demand generation through HCPs
* Monitor the Distributor operations and collaborate with Different departments within Ego to ensure accurate forecasting and inventory l evels within the distributor


**About You**
 To be successful in this position, you must meet the following criteria:
   

  

* Experience across Medical or Pharmaceutical Sales in leadership roles
* Ability to lead teams through motivating and empowering individuals
* Ability to maintain positive relationships and manage stakeholders appropriately


 For more details on this exciting opportunity, please click “Apply”.
